reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:150-162, santizeAnchors only loops while matcher.find() matches anchors in the translated value and never checks whether englishMatcher.find() still has unmatched anchors remaining from englishValue. Because verifySafeHtml at lines 88-112 performs no other anchor presence check, a translation that drops an anchor tag from the source still passes verification.
